newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to off 0.05.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to off 0.05.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to 0.05 cent weaker Tuesday, with speculators expected to continue liquidating long May positions ahead of the contract's expiry, dealers said.
The market also remains overbought after rallying to seven-month highs, they added.
Monday, spot May settled down 0.09 cent at 11.24 cents a lb after trading from 11.12 to 11.27. July fell 0.03 cent to 11.13, while the outer months eased 0.01 to 0.06 cent.
Light support for the May contract was seen at 11.08-11.10 and then at 10.80-10.90, traders said. To the upside, resistance was pegged at ast week's high of 11.38.
LIFFE white sugar futures stood lower early Tuesday, with May down $1.50 to $305.00, at 0855 EDT/1355 GMT. The outer contracts were $0.90 lower to up $0.80.

A strike at Brazil's port of Santos has paralyzed operations there, a union official said, adding that the strike could spread to Brazil's other ports. A port offical could not be reached to confirm the details of the strike, however.
((-- S Rostler New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
